title: Microstructure Study for the Effect of Ionotropic Gelation in COOH-Based Binders in Multivalent Ion Batteries
content: Multivalent ion batteries (MIBs) have garnered considerable interest as promising alternatives to lithium-ion batteries (LIBs) due to their impressive energy density and the ability to utilize abundantly available natural resources [1]. However, the mechanical stability and essential electrochemical performance of MIB electrodes can degrade during cycling, primarily due to the substantial expansion of active materials and slow ion transport, underscoring the need for advanced binder designs.
